regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing (47% eligible) rotation with 'Memory, HBM & Storage' as nominal leader but ineligible and breadth 0.0, while 'Big Pharma' (eligible, durability 0.85, breadth 1.0, crowded) is the de facto sustained leadership — a defensive, crowded top-heavy structure. Gate helps on this market, but cross-sectional momentum itself is a focus lens, not an alpha source; I am only flagging trend-tempered leans.
emerging_watch: Watch whether 'Memory, HBM & Storage' (SMH proxy) regains trend eligibility and breadth above 0.3 while 'Big Pharma' durability rolls below 0.7 — that combination would be the first observable sign of a CONFIRMED leadership handoff away from defensives; until then the narrowing rotation favors the defensive themes above.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the highest eligible rank with the strongest trend-health profile: era_gate eligible=true, durability 0.85 (highest of any eligible theme), hurst_tag trend, breadth 1.0 and r10 positive. The absolute-trend gate — the only validated risk-control leg — confirms the theme is in a stable uptrend, so the lean is to remain constructive on trend with de-risking on a confirmed trend break rather than to chase.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z=1.48 (crowded) and val_state 'confirming' at late-cycle high dispersion; defensive leadership could reverse sharply if the macro unscheduled-surprise environment flips risk-on, and the detector has no basket-level return forecast.

falsifier.text: PPH breaks below its own 50-day average and stays below for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care (EW) is a near-identical defensive twin of Big Pharma (XLV proxy) with eligibility true, durability 0.81, breadth 0.93 and trend tag. The trend gate supports staying with the broader defensive complex while it remains above trend, on the same discipline basis as Big Pharma — not on momentum rank.
evidence: crowding_z=1.56 (sizing caution only, not a fade)
theses.dissent: Equally crowded (z=1.56) and highly correlated with the Big Pharma leader; if the defensive rotation unwinds, both themes fall together and there is no diversification benefit from holding both.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks below its own 50-day average and stays below for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Staples is the most crowded eligible theme (crowding_z=1.99) but still eligible with durability 0.82 and trend tag — a classic late-cycle defensive leadership leg. The trend gate keeps it legitimate while above trend, but the crowding flag means the lean is a lower-conviction 'stay, not chase' and only survives while the absolute-trend condition holds.
evidence: crowding_z=1.99 (most crowded eligible — size-down caution per guardrails, not a fade)
narrative_rotation guardrails: crowding only DOWN-SIZES, never a sell
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding (z=1.99) means any mean-reversion in defensive positioning would hit staples hardest; the detector's own basket-extension finding says crowding has no basket-level forward edge, so it offers no timing benefit.

falsifier.text: XLP breaks below its own 50-day average and stays below for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date
